name: Ports of Call
address: Cayuga Lake Wine Trail, 2770 Ernsberger Rd, Romulus, NY 14541
description: A self-guided Cayuga Lake Wine Trail winter food-and-wine pairing event. Participating wineries pair their wines with foods inspired by international ports of call.

name: Bacon on the Lakein
address: Cayuga Lake Wine Trail, 2770 Ernsberger Rd, Romulus, NY 14541
description: A Cayuga Lake Wine Trail event where participating wineries serve bacon-inspired dishes paired with local wines. The punning name is the official spelling used by the trail.

name: Bines Fest
address: Climbing Bines Hop Farm & Craft Ale Company, 511 Hansen Point Rd, Penn Yan, NY 14527
description: A hop-harvest festival at Climbing Bines Hop Farm & Craft Ale Company near Seneca Lake. A current official event date could not be confirmed from the public event page.

name: Dickens Christmas in Skaneateles
address: Downtown Skaneateles, Genesee St, Skaneateles, NY 13152
hoursNote: Nov 28-Dec 24, 2025; weekends noon-4pm, Christmas Eve noon-2:30pm
description: A Victorian-themed holiday street festival in downtown Skaneateles with costumed Dickens characters, carolers, and seasonal activities. It opens the day after Thanksgiving and runs weekends through Christmas Eve.

name: Chocolate & Wine
address: Seneca Lake Wine Trail, 2 N Franklin St, Suite 320, Watkins Glen, NY 14891
description: A self-guided Seneca Lake Wine Trail weekend featuring chocolate-inspired food pairings with wine. Ticket holders visit participating wineries around Seneca Lake during the event window.

name: Finger Lakes GrassRoots Festival of Music and Dance
address: Trumansburg Fairgrounds, 2150 Trumansburg Rd, Trumansburg, NY 14886
description: A four-day music and dance festival held annually at the Trumansburg Fairgrounds near Cayuga Lake. The event features multiple stages, camping, workshops, family activities, and a wide range of roots and world music.

name: F.L.X. Summer Fest at The Glen
address: Watkins Glen International, 2790 County Route 16, Watkins Glen, NY 14891
hoursNote: Rebranded from Finger Lakes Wine Festival; 2025 event was canceled and no 2026 date was verified
description: Watkins Glen International rebranded the long-running Finger Lakes Wine Festival as F.L.X. Summer Fest at The Glen. The announced 2025 edition was canceled, so this listing should be reviewed before publication.

name: Finger Lakes Winter Carnival
address: Canandaigua, NY 14424
description: A winter festival centered in Canandaigua with activities at venues such as The Lake House on Canandaigua, Bristol Mountain, New York Kitchen, and downtown Canandaigua. The event includes winter recreation, tastings, shopping, and family activities.

name: Fire & Ice Celebration
address: Watkins Glen Harbor Hotel, 16 N Franklin St, Watkins Glen, NY 14891
description: A winter celebration at Watkins Glen Harbor Hotel with ice sculptures, ice bars, fire pits, regional food and beverages, live entertainment, and fireworks over Seneca Lake. The event benefits local health-care causes and is for adults 21 and older.

name: Fly-in / Drive-in Breakfast
description: Several Finger Lakes-area airports and flying clubs host fly-in/drive-in pancake breakfasts, but the OCR candidate could not be tied to one specific recurring event. Editorial review is needed before assigning a venue or date.

name: Geneva Music Festival
address: Geneva, NY 14456
description: A multi-week music festival presenting classical, jazz, bluegrass, and other performances at venues in and around Geneva. The nonprofit festival pairs professional musicians with Finger Lakes venues and wine-country settings.

name: Glorious Garlic Festival
address: Lakefront Park, 35 Lake Front Dr, Geneva, NY 14456
description: A two-day outdoor food festival on the Geneva waterfront celebrating garlic and local agriculture. The event features farms and vendors, cooking demonstrations, live music, and regional wine, beer, cider, and food.

name: Hammondsport Festival of Crafts
address: Pulteney Square, Hammondsport, NY 14840
description: An annual outdoor craft festival held in Hammondsport's village square. The event features artisan vendors, food, and entertainment in the historic Keuka Lake village.

name: Hunt Country Vineyards Annual Harvest Festival
address: Hunt Country Vineyards, 4021 Italy Hill Rd, Branchport, NY 14418
description: An annual harvest celebration at Hunt Country Vineyards in Branchport. Activities include grape stomping, tours, live music, food, and wine tastings at the Keuka Lake winery.

name: Holiday Shopping Spree
address: Cayuga Lake Wine Trail, 2770 Ernsberger Rd, Romulus, NY 14541
description: A Cayuga Lake Wine Trail holiday event combining wine-and-food pairings with seasonal shopping. Participating wineries offer tastings, recipes, ornaments, and purchase discounts during two event weekends.

name: Schuyler County Italian American Festival
address: Clute Park, 155 S Clute Park Dr, Watkins Glen, NY 14891
description: A Watkins Glen community festival celebrating Italian-American culture at Clute Park on Seneca Lake. The event features food, live entertainment, rides, crafts, a parade, fireworks, and nonprofit fundraising.

name: It's A Wonderful Life Festival
address: Downtown Seneca Falls, NY 13148
description: An annual Seneca Falls festival celebrating the town's connection to the 1946 film It's a Wonderful Life. Events take place at multiple downtown venues and include film-related programs, guest appearances, and holiday activities.

name: Keuka Arts Festival
address: Keuka Lake Outlet Trail and Penn Yan Boat Launch, Penn Yan, NY 14527
description: An annual juried outdoor arts festival along the Keuka Lake Outlet Trail in Penn Yan. The event features artists, live music, wine tastings, and food vendors.

name: Naples Grape Festival
address: Memorial Town Hall and Naples High School, N Main St, Naples, NY 14512
description: A two-day fall festival in Naples celebrating the Finger Lakes grape harvest. The event includes artisan vendors, live music, local wine and craft beverages, and Naples grape pies.

name: Go Bowling at The Glen
address: Watkins Glen International, 2790 County Route 16, Watkins Glen, NY 14891
description: The annual NASCAR Cup Series road-course race weekend at Watkins Glen International. The event brings NASCAR racing to the Finger Lakes at the historic road course near Watkins Glen.

name: Rosé in May
address: Seneca Lake Wine Trail, 2 N Franklin St, Suite 320, Watkins Glen, NY 14891
hoursNote: May 5-11, 2025, during participating wineries' regular tasting hours
description: A week-long Seneca Lake Wine Trail tasting pass focused on rosé wines. Pass holders visit participating wineries for rosé samples and additional tastings during each winery's regular hours.

name: Wings & Wheels: Seaplane and Car Show
address: Depot Park, 16 Water St, Hammondsport, NY 14840
description: A Glenn H. Curtiss Museum event in Hammondsport featuring seaplane activity on Keuka Lake and a car show. The event highlights the region's aviation heritage and the legacy of Glenn Curtiss.

name: Smoke on the Water BBQ Competition
address: Hammondsport Volunteer Fire Department carnival grounds, 8521 State Route 54, Hammondsport, NY 14840
description: An annual Hammondsport Volunteer Fire Department barbecue competition at the south end of Keuka Lake. The community event includes judged barbecue categories, public tasting wristbands, live music, and family activities.

name: Smokin' Summer Kickoff
address: Seneca Lake Wine Trail, 2 N Franklin St, Suite 320, Watkins Glen, NY 14891
description: A Seneca Lake Wine Trail summer barbecue-themed wine-and-food pairing event. Ticket holders visit participating wineries for a food pairing, wine sample, and additional tastings.

name: Spring Wine and Cheese
address: Seneca Lake Wine Trail, 2 N Franklin St, Suite 320, Watkins Glen, NY 14891
description: A Seneca Lake Wine Trail spring weekend event featuring wine and cheese-themed food pairings. The self-guided format includes participating wineries around Seneca Lake.

name: Wine & Cheese Lovers
address: Keuka Lake Wine Trail, 2375 State Route 14A, Penn Yan, NY 14527
description: A Keuka Lake Wine Trail event featuring curated wine and cheese pairings at participating member wineries. Ticket holders follow an itinerary with wine samples and experiences along the trail.

name: Wine & Herb
address: Cayuga Lake Wine Trail, 2770 Ernsberger Rd, Romulus, NY 14541
description: A Cayuga Lake Wine Trail spring event where participating wineries pair wines with herb-themed foods. Guests collect potted herbs or vegetable plants and recipes as they travel the trail.

name: Wine Country Classic Boat Show
address: Depot Park, Hammondsport, NY 14840
description: An antique and classic boat show and regatta on Keuka Lake in Hammondsport. The event is organized by Wine Country Classic Boats and includes displays, a parade, awards, and a Sunday non-motorized regatta.

name: CMAC Performing Arts
address: Constellation Brands-Marvin Sands Performing Arts Center, 3355 Marvin Sands Dr, Canandaigua, NY 14424
hoursNote: Annual summer concert season, generally late May through August
description: An outdoor amphitheater on the Finger Lakes Community College campus in Canandaigua. CMAC hosts a seasonal concert series with national touring acts and community performances rather than one single festival date.

name: Ring of Fire
address: Canandaigua Lake shoreline, Canandaigua, NY 14424
description: A Labor Day weekend community tradition in which residents around Canandaigua Lake light flares or bonfires at dusk to form a ring around the shoreline. Visit Finger Lakes describes the tradition as rooted in a Seneca harvest ritual and marks Bare Hill as the ceremonial first fire.
